subject: Request: Courtesy billing correction and VAT treatment for Nov invoice
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@pearlhealth.io>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Accounting <acct@pearlhealth.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected tax line on Nov invoice — need correction

Hi Rachel,

We were reviewing our November invoice from Redwood (INV-2026-11-PEARL) and noticed a line item described as 'Platform surcharge' for $12,800 that we didn't anticipate. Our agreement (SOW v2) and the pricing sheet used for the renewal don't list any platform surcharge — total usage and overage numbers match our internal logs.

Separately, the invoice charged VAT at 20% for services, but our company is VAT-registered in the UK and we provided a VAT registration certificate during onboarding (attached again here). Per our contract and tax rules, Redwood should not be charging VAT on a B2B UK-registered customer with a valid VAT number.

Can you please:
- Confirm why the surcharge appeared and remove it if it was applied in error
- Reissue the invoice without VAT (or provide VAT-free billing instructions)
- Provide a credit or refund for any overcharge so our accounts can close the month

Attaching: pearl-invoice-2026-11.pdf, vat-registration-pearlhealth.pdf

We need something by COB Monday to close books. Appreciate a quick confirmation of next steps.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Procurement | Pearl Health
elena.ortiz@pearlhealth.io
+1 (415) 555-0147
From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@pearlhealth.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected tax line on Nov invoice — need correction

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the attachments. I'm sorry for the disruption here.

Short version: we will make this right. Preliminary review looks like the 'platform surcharge' was an automated system tag that should not have applied to your contract tier — full stop. I am proposing a courtesy credit for the full $12,800 and reissue the November invoice without VAT as long as we validate the VAT registration details.

Planned next steps (I'll coordinate on our side, please confirm acceptance):
1) Finance to approve goodwill/courtesy credit of $12,800 and issue a credit note applied to INV-2026-11.
2) Reissue an adjusted invoice (INV-2026-11-A) without the VAT line and with a net amount reflecting the credit.
3) If you prefer a refund instead of a credit, we can process that once approvals are in place.
4) Please confirm the VAT registration number on the attached document and whether Pearl Health wants a credit note or a refund.

Marcus/laura — looping you both for the approval path and accounting entries. Can we get sign-off and the credit note issued today so Elena's team can close books Monday? Suggested accounting codes: revenue-contracredit / tax-adjustment.

Elena — I appreciate the quick heads up. I will follow up once Marcus confirms.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 07:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected tax line on Nov invoice — approval for courtesy credit

Rachel / Laura — I reviewed the invoice and Elena's attachments. This is clearly an erroneous automated tag — no contractual basis for the surcharge. I approve the following:

- Issue a goodwill credit note: CREDIT-PEARL-2026-11 for $12,800 (apply to INV-2026-11).
- Reissue corrected invoice INV-2026-11-A removing the surcharge and VAT charge. Net effect: zero VAT, net due reduced by the credit.
- If Pearl requests a refund, finance to process a ACH refund to their primary payment method; otherwise credit to their account for future invoices.

Accounting entries:
- Debit revenue-contra $12,800
- Debit VAT payable reversal $2,560 (if VAT had been remitted; if not remitted, note in accounting memo)
- Reissue invoice with reference to credit note and include auditor-friendly text: 'Courtesy credit issued for erroneously applied platform surcharge; VAT reversed per client VAT registration on file.'

Attaching: credit-note-PEARL-2026-11.pdf (draft). Laura, please finalize the credit note PDF and post reissued invoice to the accounting portal. Once done, cc: acct@pearlhealth.io and Rachel for confirmation to the customer.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@pearlhealth.io>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Accounting <acct@pearlhealth.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected tax line on Nov invoice — need correction

Rachel / Marcus — thank you, that path works for us.

Pearl Health prefers a credit note applied to the invoice (we want the credit on file for year-end). Please proceed with:
- Apply CREDIT-PEARL-2026-11 to INV-2026-11
- Reissue INV-2026-11-A without VAT and mark it paid by credit note in the portal

I also need a pro forma or confirmation letter our AP team can file showing the reversal and credit note (reason: auditing bank of Pearl Health). Can you include the VAT registration number in the confirmation letter to show why VAT was reversed?

Once you send the reissued invoice and pro forma I will sign off and close the month. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena
